Dialogs.Dialog: What a coincidence！ Out for a walk？
Running into each other like this is kind of nice.
Yeah, I was thinking the same.
...Hehe, we're the same, huh？ I'm happy.
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Out for a walk again today？
Oh, sorry. You startled me a little...
I had a feeling I might see you, so I came here. And then...
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Haha, we meet again.
I feel like little moments like this make our bond stronger.
Hehe, right？ Seeing a movie now？
So that means ▲高嶺＊＊▲ already saw it.
Yes. If I'd known, we should have made plans. Just kidding.
Oh, the next showing's about to start. Go on, I'll see you off.
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. We sure run into each other a lot.
By the way, you are alone, right？
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... We really do keep running into each other.
At this point, maybe we're destined to be inseparable？
...Geez, don't answer so fast. It's embarrassing...
Yeah, well... What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
If you were coming, I should have stayed a little longer.
I see. I should have come a little earlier, too.
Oh. There's a cute trainer here, but don't look too much, okay？
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Did we just miss each other again？
Looks like it. Hey, are you doing this on purpose？
Hehe！ I can't tell if the god of coincidence is mean or kind, can you？
Ah. Missed each other again, huh...
Hehe, maybe this is just our fate.
Even without plans, we find each other wherever we go... Just kidding.
Then we can't fight it, huh？
Yeah, something like that. What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Me too. But I'm just heading home.
Your face is red. A fever？
No！ It's nothing. It's just... running into you in a place like this feels kind of new...
And it made my heart race a little, that's all. Sorry for saying something weird.
We sure run into each other. Heading home already？
Yes. And you're just getting here... Bad timing. That's such a shame.
But, I'm so happy to see you. Enjoy shopping, okay？
Somehow, I had a feeling I'd run into you.
Maybe it's not chance, but destiny？ Just kidding. Hehe！
Hey there. You alone？ Free right now？
That sounds like something a guy trying to pick someone up would say.
How about some tea at a cafe around here？
No, thank you. I'm in the middle of errands.
Hey, pretty lady, want to get some tea？
Ah. ...Geez, calling out to me like that again...
Yes. I need to head home now.
Hey, handsome, how about some tea？
Geez. If you were coming, you should've told me first.
But meeting like this is nice too, isn't it？ It feels fresh.
Just, of all places to run into you.
Change？ Oh, maybe you need coins for a bazaar or something？
Getting change for that kind of thing isn't allowed, right？
It's a secret. Hehe, bye. Have fun.
(I feel like I just saw something strange...)
Yeah, well, something like that... I guess？
Isn't it about time you told me the truth？
▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Today I'm not letting you get away！
Geez, getting so worked up. Cute.
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What a coincidence. Shopping？
More like scouting things out, I guess？ What about you？
Hehe, what's that supposed to mean？
Hmm, not really... Oh, could I ask your advice sometime？
Sorry, Mama's waiting for me over there.
I see. Got it. See you next time, then.
Today it's more like wa-a-andering around.
But I'm happy to see you, so I'll let it slide？ Just kidding.
Yeah, just wandering around again today...
Hehe. But I get it. This place never gets old.
Still, don't you dare neglect me, okay？ Make sure to take me on dates！
Oh, what a coincidence. Shopping too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, I wanted a CD of piano music.
I see. Find a good one？
Yes. Are you just getting here？
I see. Too bad... I need to head home.
But I'm glad we ran into each other, even by chance. I'll enjoy the CD even more now.
Hehe, I've heard that line before.
Hahaha. Find a CD you like？
No, not today. I'm going home empty-handed.
But I got to see you... so I guess that's my haul？ Hehe.
We ran into each other again, huh？
Maybe we can't call this a coincidence anymore.
I've been thinking that all along, you know？
Yeah, sort of... What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, I saw a cute doll. But the price gave me a shock.
And the next shock was you.
I didn't expect to see you. Hehe, lucky me.
Want to take me home instead, then？
Hehe, I'll take you up on that another time▼ Just kidding.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. You like this place, huh？
Yes, there's so much here, it's fun.
And I get to see you like this, too？
We run into each other way too often for it to be chance.
Hehe, it makes you happy, right？ Just kidding.
Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you doing here？
No, it's not bad... It just seems distracting.
It's not that kind of studying, so it's fine.
Hm？ Then what kind of studying？
Well, you know. Okay, see you？
No... I mean, it's fine, but...
Yes. Someday I might be able to show you the results...？
Maybe you can look forward to it？
Well, guess I'd better get going.
You know, I was just thinking about you. And then there you really were. It surprised me.
Well, guess I'd better get going.
I only caught a glimpse of you from far away. Hehe, I'm glad I followed you.
Well, guess I'd better get going.
